record.question: What should be done when a file categorized as 'Secret' or 'Top Secret' is demanded by an Audit or Accounts officer?
options: The file must be handed over promptly
An in-principle approval of the next higher authority must be obtained, and then handed over promptly
The file may be sent personally to the Head of the Audit Office specifying this fact, who will then deal with it in accordance with the standing instructions
The demand should be refused and promptly reported to the Government
